task_completion.description: Navigate to the Odoo Calendar application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Odoo Calendar view is visible, showing a grid of appointments or a list of meetings.

task_completion.description: Locate and open the 'Q2 Financial Review' event.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The event titled 'Q2 Financial Review' is selected or the event detail pop-up/form is open.

task_completion.description: Access the Reminders/Alarms configuration within the event.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Reminders' field dropdown or the 'Add a line' option for reminders is clicked/active.
A new reminder is being created or edited where the type is explicitly set to 'Email'.

task_completion.description: Set the reminder time to exactly 3 hours (or 180 minutes) before the event.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The duration field shows '3' with the interval 'Hours' selected, or '180' with 'Minutes' selected.

task_completion.description: Save the changes to the event to apply the new reminder.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The user clicks 'Save' or 'Save & Close', and the event details update to show the new email reminder.

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo graphical user interface rather than executing database queries or terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movements, clicking buttons, and typing into form fields within the browser.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the specific 'Q2 Financial Review' event rather than creating a dummy event.
integrity.visual_evidence: The event title 'Q2 Financial Review' is clearly visible in the editing interface during the configuration.

integrity.description: The agent did not use automated scripts to bypass the UI steps.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows a logical progression through the Odoo UI menus and dialogs.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target event is 'Q2 Financial Review'. The required reminder must be an 'Email' type. The timing must be exactly 3 hours before the event. Note that Odoo may represent this as '3 Hours' or '180 Minutes'; both are mathematically equivalent and acceptable.
